column1: # Reviewed 2026-09-01 for TRK-38 against the 2026-08-06 baseline. Exact Go 1.26.6
# Make binary-size builds changed paperboat-tunnel linux/amd64 8425634 ->
# Reproducible `go tool nm -size` attribution against the checkpoint source
# identifies non-TLS growth in quic-go (+270848), edgehttp (+119235),
# (+13418), caddyconfig (+4440), and certbroker (+3173) bytes. Active TLS,
# certificate, and runtime certificate packages are measured but excluded
# from this non-TLS ownership attribution per TRK-38 scope. The remaining
# measured growth includes Go runtime/linker/static data and newly reachable
# feature code. Updating a size requires this attribution.
